Three ways to read. No need to rush.

Flow uses rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP): words appear one at a time around a fixed point. Bold beginnings emphasizes the first part of each word. Classic keeps the original text. Choose what feels comfortable; a faster pace does not necessarily mean better understanding. Pause to reflect, and lower the speed for unfamiliar material.

Reading background: speed-reading research review · bold-text reading study.

Made for a calmer kind of reading.
